title: EnableMovement - InputEnableLayer
content:
Member of: InputEnableLayer Script Enables or disables the player's ability to move on this layer. Syntax: Function EnableMovement(abEnable = true) native Parameters: - abEnable: If true, enables movement. Otherwise disables it. Default: True Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable movement myLayer.EnableMovement()
; Disable movement InputEnableLayer myLayer = InputEnableLayer.Create() myLayer.EnableMovement(false) See Also: - InputEnableLayer Script - IsMovementEnabled - InputEnableLayer
